'''2007 Worlds Team Greg Shaw DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Greg Shaw]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB Operations]]
* '''Stage:''' Team
